sammendrag: 'The effects of the German unemployment compensation system on the duration of unemployment are analyzed. In particular, the successive extensions of benefit entitlement periods in the 1980's are used to identify these effects. The econometric analysis is based on a hazard rate model estimated on waves 1-12 of the German Socio-Economic Panel covering the period 1983 to 1994. I find strong evidence for entitlement effects for men, but not for women. However, long-term unemployment is much more affected if unemployment assistance, which tends to be open-ended, is avaible after the exhaustion of unemployment benefits. On the other hand, simulations show that even large reductions of the income-replacement ratio have very little effect on the duration of unemployment.' (author's abstract)
tittel: Extended benefit entitlement periods and the duration of unemployment in West Germany
